question_en: Which statements are true? 1) The capacitance of a capacitor does not depend on its charge. 2) In series the total capacitance is larger than the largest one. 3) Capacitors in parallel have the same voltage. 4) The energy of a capacitor is $W=CU$.
question_uz: Qaysi fikrlar to'g'ri? 1) Kondensator sig'imi uning zaryadiga bog'liq emas. 2) Ketma-ket ulashda umumiy sig'im eng katta sig'imdan katta. 3) Parallel ulangan kondensatorlar kuchlanishi bir xil. 4) Kondensator energiyasi $W=CU$.
question_ru: Какие утверждения верны? 1) Ёмкость конденсатора не зависит от его заряда. 2) При последовательном соединении общая ёмкость больше наибольшей. 3) Напряжения параллельно соединённых конденсаторов одинаковы. 4) Энергия конденсатора $W=CU$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. 1 va 3 to'g'ri; ketma-ket ulashda sig'im eng kichigidan ham kichik, energiya W = CU²/2.
Asos: sig'im va ulash qoidalari.

distractors_en.A: statement 2 is false: series reduces capacitance
distractors_en.E: statement 4 is false and statement 1 is true

question_en: A capacitor connected to $300\ \mathrm{V}$ acquires a charge of $12\ \mathrm{nC}$. Find its capacitance ($\mathrm{pF}$).
question_uz: Kondensator $300\ \mathrm{V}$ ga ulanganda $12\ \mathrm{nC}$ zaryad oldi. Uning sig'imini toping ($\mathrm{pF}$).
question_ru: Конденсатор, подключённый к $300\ \mathrm{V}$, получил заряд $12\ \mathrm{nC}$. Найдите его ёмкость ($\mathrm{pF}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. C = q/U = 12·10⁻⁹/300 = 4·10⁻¹¹ F = 40 pF.
Asos: sig'im ta'rifi.

distractors.D: bu nF da, pF da emas

distractors_ru.D: это в nF, а не в pF

distractors_en.D: this is in nF, not pF

question_en: Each plate of a parallel-plate capacitor has an area of $40\ \mathrm{cm^2}$, the gap is $3.54\ \mathrm{mm}$ and $\varepsilon=2$. Find the capacitance ($\mathrm{pF}$). $\varepsilon_0=8.85\cdot10^{-12}\ \mathrm{F/m}$.
question_uz: Yassi kondensator qoplamalari yuzi $40\ \mathrm{cm^2}$ dan, ular orasi $3.54\ \mathrm{mm}$, dielektrik singdiruvchanlik $\varepsilon=2$. Sig'imni toping ($\mathrm{pF}$). $\varepsilon_0=8.85\cdot10^{-12}\ \mathrm{F/m}$.
question_ru: Площадь каждой обкладки плоского конденсатора $40\ \mathrm{cm^2}$, расстояние между ними $3.54\ \mathrm{mm}$, диэлектрическая проницаемость $\varepsilon=2$. Найдите ёмкость ($\mathrm{pF}$). $\varepsilon_0=8.85\cdot10^{-12}\ \mathrm{F/m}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. C = εε₀S/d = 2 · 8.85·10⁻¹² · 4·10⁻³/3.54·10⁻³ = 2·10⁻¹¹ F = 20 pF.
Asos: yassi kondensator sig'imi.

distractors_en.D: cm² were converted to m² incorrectly
distractors_en.E: mm were converted to metres incorrectly

question_en: Capacitors of $6\ \mathrm{nF}$ and $12\ \mathrm{nF}$ are connected in series. Find the total capacitance ($\mathrm{nF}$).
question_uz: Sig'imlari $6\ \mathrm{nF}$ va $12\ \mathrm{nF}$ bo'lgan kondensatorlar ketma-ket ulangan. Umumiy sig'imni toping ($\mathrm{nF}$).
question_ru: Конденсаторы ёмкостью $6\ \mathrm{nF}$ и $12\ \mathrm{nF}$ соединены последовательно. Найдите общую ёмкость ($\mathrm{nF}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. C = C₁C₂/(C₁ + C₂) = 72/18 = 4 nF — eng kichik sig'imdan ham kichik.
Asos: ketma-ket ulash.

question_en: $5$ capacitors of $40\ \mathrm{nF}$ each are connected in series. Find the total capacitance ($\mathrm{nF}$).
question_uz: Har birining sig'imi $40\ \mathrm{nF}$ bo'lgan $5$ ta kondensator ketma-ket ulangan. Umumiy sig'imni toping ($\mathrm{nF}$).
question_ru: $5$ конденсаторов ёмкостью по $40\ \mathrm{nF}$ соединены последовательно. Найдите общую ёмкость ($\mathrm{nF}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. n ta bir xil kondensator ketma-ket: C = C₀/n = 40/5 = 8 nF.
Asos: ketma-ket ulash.

distractors_en.A: this is the parallel result nC₀

question_en: A $2\ \mu\mathrm{F}$ capacitor is charged to $300\ \mathrm{V}$. Find its energy ($\mathrm{J}$).
question_uz: Sig'imi $2\ \mu\mathrm{F}$ bo'lgan kondensator $300\ \mathrm{V}$ gacha zaryadlangan. Uning energiyasini toping ($\mathrm{J}$).
question_ru: Конденсатор ёмкостью $2\ \mu\mathrm{F}$ заряжен до $300\ \mathrm{V}$. Найдите его энергию ($\mathrm{J}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. W = CU²/2 = 2·10⁻⁶ · 9·10⁴/2 = 0.09 J.
Asos: kondensator energiyasi.

distractors_ru.C: это заряд CU, а не энергия
distractors_ru.E: взято CU/2 — U не в квадрате

distractors_en.C: this is the charge CU, not the energy
distractors_en.D: μF were not converted to farads
distractors_en.E: CU/2 was used; U was not squared

question_en: Capacitors of $2\ \mu\mathrm{F}$ and $6\ \mu\mathrm{F}$ are connected in series to $160\ \mathrm{V}$. Find the voltage on the $2\ \mu\mathrm{F}$ capacitor ($\mathrm{V}$).
question_uz: Sig'imlari $2\ \mu\mathrm{F}$ va $6\ \mu\mathrm{F}$ bo'lgan kondensatorlar ketma-ket ulanib, $160\ \mathrm{V}$ ga ulandi. $2\ \mu\mathrm{F}$ li kondensatordagi kuchlanishni toping ($\mathrm{V}$).
question_ru: Конденсаторы ёмкостью $2\ \mu\mathrm{F}$ и $6\ \mu\mathrm{F}$ соединены последовательно и подключены к $160\ \mathrm{V}$. Найдите напряжение на конденсаторе $2\ \mu\mathrm{F}$ ($\mathrm{V}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. U₁/U₂ = C₂/C₁ = 3, U₁ + U₂ = 160: U₁ = 120 V — kichik sig'imda kuchlanish katta.
Asos: ketma-ket ulash.

distractors_en.A: this is the voltage on the larger capacitor

question_en: A $2\ \mu\mathrm{F}$ capacitor charged to $100\ \mathrm{V}$ is disconnected and connected in parallel with an uncharged $6\ \mu\mathrm{F}$ capacitor. Find the common voltage ($\mathrm{V}$).
question_uz: $100\ \mathrm{V}$ gacha zaryadlangan $2\ \mu\mathrm{F}$ kondensator manbadan uzilib, zaryadsiz $6\ \mu\mathrm{F}$ kondensatorga parallel ulandi. Umumiy kuchlanishni toping ($\mathrm{V}$).
question_ru: Конденсатор $2\ \mu\mathrm{F}$, заряженный до $100\ \mathrm{V}$, отключили от источника и соединили параллельно с незаряженным конденсатором $6\ \mu\mathrm{F}$. Найдите общее напряжение ($\mathrm{V}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. Zaryad saqlanadi: 2 · 100 = (2 + 6)U′, U′ = 25 V.
Asos: zaryadning saqlanishi.

distractors.E: bu ikkinchi kondensatorga o'tgan zaryad ulushi

distractors_ru.E: это доля заряда, перешедшего на второй

distractors_en.E: this is the fraction of charge moved to the second one

question_en: An air capacitor is charged and disconnected from the source. Then the gap is filled with a dielectric of $\varepsilon=4$. By what factor does the energy change ($\frac{W'}{W}$)?
question_uz: Havo kondensatori zaryadlanib, manbadan uzildi. So'ng qoplamalar orasi $\varepsilon=4$ bo'lgan dielektrik bilan to'ldirildi. Energiya necha marta o'zgaradi ($\frac{W'}{W}$)?
question_ru: Воздушный конденсатор зарядили и отключили от источника. Затем пространство между обкладками заполнили диэлектриком с $\varepsilon=4$. Во сколько раз изменится энергия ($\frac{W'}{W}$)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. Uzilgan kondensatorda q = const, C 4 marta ortadi, W = q²/(2C) 4 marta kamayadi.
Asos: W = q²/(2C).

distractors.E: ε kvadratga oshirilgan va teskari olingan

question_en: The plate separation of a parallel-plate capacitor connected to a source is reduced $3$ times. By what factor does the energy change ($\frac{W'}{W}$)?
question_uz: Manbaga ulangan yassi kondensator qoplamalari orasidagi masofa $3$ marta kamaytirildi. Energiya necha marta o'zgaradi ($\frac{W'}{W}$)?
question_ru: Расстояние между обкладками плоского конденсатора, подключённого к источнику, уменьшили в $3$ раза. Во сколько раз изменится энергия ($\frac{W'}{W}$)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. Manbaga ulangan: U = const, C 3 marta ortadi, W = CU²/2 ham 3 marta ortadi.
Asos: W = CU²/2.

distractors.C: masofa kvadratga oshirilgan va teskari olingan

distractors_en.C: the distance was squared and inverted

question_en: In a medium with relative permittivity $5$, a uniform electric field has a strength of $2\cdot10^4\ \mathrm{V/m}$. Find the energy density of the field ($\mathrm{J/m^3}$). $\varepsilon_0=8.85\cdot10^{-12}\ \mathrm{F/m}$.
question_uz: Dielektrik singdiruvchanligi $5$ bo'lgan muhitda bir jinsli elektr maydon kuchlanganligi $2\cdot10^4\ \mathrm{V/m}$. Maydon energiyasi zichligini toping ($\mathrm{J/m^3}$). $\varepsilon_0=8.85\cdot10^{-12}\ \mathrm{F/m}$.
question_ru: В среде с диэлектрической проницаемостью $5$ напряжённость однородного электрического поля $2\cdot10^4\ \mathrm{V/m}$. Найдите плотность энергии поля ($\mathrm{J/m^3}$). $\varepsilon_0=8.85\cdot10^{-12}\ \mathrm{F/m}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. w = εε₀E²/2 = 5 · 8.85·10⁻¹² · 4·10⁸/2 = 8.85·10⁻³ J/m³.
Asos: energiya zichligi.

question_en: Find the capacitance of an isolated metal sphere of radius $4.5\ \mathrm{cm}$ in vacuum ($\mathrm{pF}$).
question_uz: Vakuumdagi radiusi $4.5\ \mathrm{cm}$ bo'lgan yakkalangan metall sharning sig'imini toping ($\mathrm{pF}$).
question_ru: Найдите ёмкость уединённого металлического шара радиусом $4.5\ \mathrm{cm}$ в вакууме ($\mathrm{pF}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. C = 4πε₀R = R/k = 0.045/(9·10⁹) = 5·10⁻¹² F = 5 pF.
Asos: shar sig'imi.

distractors_en.B: cm were converted to metres incorrectly
distractors_en.D: the radius was taken as 45 cm

question_en: Two $6\ \mu\mathrm{F}$ capacitors are connected in parallel, and a $4\ \mu\mathrm{F}$ capacitor is in series with them. Find the total capacitance ($\mu\mathrm{F}$).
question_uz: Ikkita $6\ \mu\mathrm{F}$ kondensator parallel ulangan, ularga $4\ \mu\mathrm{F}$ kondensator ketma-ket ulangan. Umumiy sig'imni toping ($\mu\mathrm{F}$).
question_ru: Два конденсатора по $6\ \mu\mathrm{F}$ соединены параллельно, к ним последовательно подключён конденсатор $4\ \mu\mathrm{F}$. Найдите общую ёмкость ($\mu\mathrm{F}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. Parallel guruh 6 + 6 = 12 μF, u 4 μF bilan ketma-ket: 12 · 4/16 = 3 μF.
Asos: aralash ulash.

distractors_en.C: one 6 μF and the 4 μF in series

question_en: In the circuit $C_1=3\ \mu\mathrm{F}$, $C_2=6\ \mu\mathrm{F}$, $C_3=4\ \mu\mathrm{F}$. Find the total capacitance between points $A$ and $B$ ($\mu\mathrm{F}$).
question_uz: Rasmdagi sxemada $C_1=3\ \mu\mathrm{F}$, $C_2=6\ \mu\mathrm{F}$, $C_3=4\ \mu\mathrm{F}$. $A$ va $B$ nuqtalar orasidagi umumiy sig'imni toping ($\mu\mathrm{F}$).
question_ru: На схеме $C_1=3\ \mu\mathrm{F}$, $C_2=6\ \mu\mathrm{F}$, $C_3=4\ \mu\mathrm{F}$. Найдите общую ёмкость между точками $A$ и $B$ ($\mu\mathrm{F}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. C₁ va C₂ ketma-ket: 3 · 6/9 = 2 μF; u C₃ ga parallel: 2 + 4 = 6 μF.
Asos: aralash ulash.

distractors.C: C₃ ga C₂ ketma-ket ulangan deb olingan

distractors_ru.C: принято, что C₂ последовательно с C₃

distractors_en.C: C₂ was taken in series with C₃

question_en: An $800\ \mu\mathrm{F}$ capacitor charged to $250\ \mathrm{V}$ discharges completely in $2.5\ \mathrm{ms}$. Find the average power ($\mathrm{kW}$).
question_uz: Sig'imi $800\ \mu\mathrm{F}$ bo'lgan, $250\ \mathrm{V}$ gacha zaryadlangan kondensator $2.5\ \mathrm{ms}$ da to'liq zaryadsizlanadi. O'rtacha quvvatni toping ($\mathrm{kW}$).
question_ru: Конденсатор ёмкостью $800\ \mu\mathrm{F}$, заряженный до $250\ \mathrm{V}$, полностью разряжается за $2.5\ \mathrm{ms}$. Найдите среднюю мощность ($\mathrm{kW}$).

distractors_en.B: the charge CU was divided by the time
distractors_en.C: ms were not converted to seconds
distractors_en.D: this is the energy (J), not the power
